research_question: Can one bounded existing-strategy plus bot-inspired recipe remain viable over adverse long-term regimes at moderately higher risk, compared with the same higher-risk CSH control?

fixed_candidates.kind: Control, not a new alpha algorithm
fixed_candidates.recipe: Multiply frozen original causal CSH targets by 1.5, then apply .30 asset/.90 gross/.15 same 30-observation covariance controller; same 9000 committed budget and 8500 actual-margin guard. Do not refit original signals.

fixed_candidates.kind: One new bounded Martingale-inspired candidate, not a Bybit bot replica
fixed_candidates.recipe: Reserve 8000 original USDT capital for the scaled CSH ownership sleeve, including its fees/funding buffer, and 1000 for one fixed finite BTC program. Total reservation remains 9000; retain 1000 uncommitted. The 10% denotes original initial capital, not 10% of the positive BTC position. Global H090 covariance/concentration/pending/capital gates apply to the COMBINED portfolio.

finite_program.add_trigger: Actual quantity-weighted filled average entry basis multiplied by .95, recalculated after each complete order
finite_program.stop_signal: Actual net sleeve PnL <= -200 USDT; a signal only, never a loss guarantee
finite_program.entry_eligibility_proposal: First causally eligible original CSH BTC-positive decision in the annual wallet; exact ownership adapter remains unimplemented
finite_program.maximum_adds_reached: Keep actual inventory marked; no automatic free closure
finite_program.receipt_completion: Only accumulated actual account-bound opening-margin receipts within one pinned 1e-8 quantity tick at actual fill price advance the order index. Partial fills and duplicate receipts do not count twice.
finite_program.restart_rule: ONE finite, non-refillable program per fresh annual wallet. Released reservations are permanently retired and cannot be reused under renamed owners. No automatic restart, compounding or new cash rescue. Multi-round behavior requires a separately prespecified reviewed model.

unchanged_accounting.only_account_diff: The max_gross_weight validation upper bound .60 to .90 in a separate vendor namespace; default .60 and all Decimal financial methods unchanged.
unchanged_accounting.funding: Original signed q*mark*rate cash arithmetic, actual caller-supplied event cadence; RAW_AS_FRACTION1 remains conditional, not certified.
unchanged_accounting.capacity: One shared per-symbol minute capacity from prior completed quote volume times .001 divided by current execution midpoint.
unchanged_accounting.clock: Original next eligible minute open +1 microsecond.
unchanged_accounting.closing: 1e-8 idealized quantity filter, opening minimum10, explicit closing exemption, unpaid residual retained.
unchanged_accounting.terminal: 60 charged real-minute reduce-only attempts in toy fixture; production terminal60 adapter parity remains an integration gate.
unchanged_accounting.liquidation: Original isolated-maintenance .005 model can HALT, does not simulate certified native liquidation or whole-wallet ruin.

fixed_metrics.probability_plan: Only after source and historical adapter admission, use past-available development segments and prespecified stationary block stress resampling with 7/30/90-day blocks, preserved cross-asset dependence, 2000 fixed-seed paths per regime/cost setting, 1/3/5-year horizons. State counts and Wilson95 intervals as conditional scenario-model probabilities; do not call them calibrated future real-world probabilities. Cost/funding/halts/paid terminal must replay the reviewed financial engine, not rescale historical PnL. Horizon extrapolation from sparse development data is explicitly uncertain.
fixed_metrics.toy_probabilities: NOT_ESTIMATED: seven hand-constructed adversarial fixtures are counterexamples, not frequency evidence.

bad_regime_coverage: persistent bear market with failure to rebound
correlated cross-asset selloff and changing correlations
long sideways market with grid/martingale cost churn
funding sign reversal, larger cumulative debit and more frequent settlements
zero/low prior-minute capacity, delayed or partial reductions
mark/trade dislocation and missing held-asset mark/execution; fail closed
large gap that jumps past a stop before executable capacity exists

development_source_rules.2022: Known mark-source gaps; not silently interpolated or completed
development_source_rules.current_2025_runs: Reuse authorized completed source checkpoints only after their own finish; do not duplicate current runs
development_source_rules.selection: No combinatorial search, winner leaderboard, multiplier/lookback optimization on seen data, or retrospective Aurora top-pick selection. Any later selector must use only past available observations and requires its own fixed preregistration.

dedup.coverage: 111 branch names plus pinned main mechanism-path/content search and sibling bounded dedup evidence. Existing expert mixtures, SMA/static50, funding rank, risk budgets, headroom and quantity grids are prior art. No named margin-multiplied finite Martingale program found in this bounded inspection.
